articles.title: DeepSeek Is Building Its Own Claude Code. Beijing Wants the Whole Stack
articles.snippet: The Chinese AI lab already powers coding agents worldwide. Now it wants to own the tool developers use to run them.

articles.title: Syndicate Labs Shuts Down as Crypto Cuts and Closures Mount
articles.snippet: The shutdown is the latest in a wave of crypto and tech cutbacks driven by weaker demand, tighter funding, and AI pivots.
